collection_metadata.locality: Auroville and Tiruvanamalai, Tamil Nadu, India

stem_bark.text: The bark is Limonia acidissima is brown in colour, ridged with vertical fissures and rectangular flakes. Sharp and straight spines, pale in colour, are found in young growth. The spines are up to 2 cm in size.
stem_bark.text_html:
The bark is Limonia acidissima is brown in colour, ridged with vertical fissures and rectangular flakes. 
Sharp and straight spines, pale in colour, are found in young growth. 
The spines are up to 2 cm in size.

images.caption: Limonia acidissima stem arrangment from the trunk
Limonia acidissima spines on young growth

seed.text: The seeds of Limonia acidissima are numerous and less than 1 cm, embedded in the pulp contained in the woody rind. The seeds are oblong and compressed, white in colour.
seed.text_html:
The seeds of Limonia acidissima are numerous and less than 1 cm, embedded in the pulp contained in the woody rind. 
The seeds are oblong and compressed, white in colour.

images.caption: Limonia acidissima seeds extracted from the pulp and dried
Limonia acidissima oblong and compressed seeds

fruit.text: The fruit of Limonia acidissima is mostly known for its hard woody ball, round to oval in shape. The fruit is a berry, 5 to 8 cm in diameter. The rind is green and brown outside and contains inside a dark brown sticky pulp. This pulp is edible, astringent, sweet or sour in taste.
fruit.text_html:
The fruit of Limonia acidissima is mostly known for its hard woody ball, round to oval in shape. 
The fruit is a berry, 5 to 8 cm in diameter. 
The rind is green and brown outside and contains inside a dark brown sticky pulp. 
This pulp is edible, astringent, sweet or sour in taste.

images.caption: Limonia acidissima open fruit showing the sticky pulp with numerous embedded seeds
Limonia acidissima young fruit on stem
